description: Anonymous user visiting web application landing page is prompted to sign in
preconditions: User is not authenticated; browser local/session storage is empty
steps: Verify presence of application branding, logo, and 'Sign in' button
expected_result: Landing page renders cleanly with 'Sign in' button; protected views are not displayed
actual_result: Landing page renders 'neuron' logo, welcome message, and accessible 'Sign in' button
notes: Verified via Playwright browser automation in live_stack.spec.ts

description: User login with valid Keycloak credentials (Alice -> neuron-user)
preconditions: Keycloak container is healthy; user alice exists in realm
steps: Observe redirect to Keycloak OIDC login form on port 8180
expected_result: Redirects back to http://localhost:5173/ with PKCE code, completes token exchange, renders sidebar with 'Signed in as alice.' and full assistant access
actual_result: Successfully authenticated via Keycloak PKCE flow; sidebar displayed 'Signed in as alice.' with Chat, Knowledge, and Data buttons
notes: Verified with real Keycloak container on 127.0.0.1:8180

description: Reader login with valid Keycloak credentials (Bob -> neuron-reader)
preconditions: Keycloak container is healthy; user bob exists in realm
steps: Enter username 'bob' and password 'dev-only-bob' on Keycloak login page
expected_result: Redirects back to web application; renders sidebar with 'Signed in as bob.'
actual_result: Authenticated as bob with role 'neuron-reader'

description: Rejection of invalid password in Keycloak login form
expected_result: Login form displays error 'Invalid username or password.'; user remains unauthenticated
actual_result: Error span #input-error-password displays 'Invalid username or password.'
notes: Strict mode element selection fixed in test suite

description: User sign-out terminates session and clears local state
preconditions: User is signed in as Alice
steps: Observe redirect to Keycloak end-session endpoint and back to root
expected_result: In-memory token cleared, user redirected to landing page, 'Sign in' button reappears
actual_result: User signed out completely; protected screens unmounted; landing page rendered

description: Direct unauthenticated API request rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized
steps: Send GET request to http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/knowledge/bases without Authorization header
expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with standard error response
actual_result: API responded with HTTP 401 and code 'unauthorized'
notes: Verified via test_security and integration suite

description: Malformed or forged JWT token rejected by API TokenVerifier
steps: Generate unsigned JWT token with alg: none or bad signature
Send GET request with forged Bearer token
expected_result: HTTP 401 / AuthenticationError raised; forged claims never trusted
actual_result: TokenVerifier rejected alg: none and signature mismatch with AuthenticationError

description: Token for mismatched audience rejected
steps: Attempt request to API with token
expected_result: Authentication failure due to audience claim mismatch
actual_result: TokenVerifier raised AuthenticationError on invalid audience

description: Create new Knowledge Base with valid name and default settings
expected_result: Knowledge base created via POST /v1/knowledge/bases; Documents panel opens
actual_result: Base created with unique kb_id; Documents in HR-Guide panel displayed immediately

description: Validation rejects empty or whitespace-only Knowledge Base name
steps: Leave 'New knowledge base' input blank or enter whitespace
expected_result: Form submission prevented; validation message 'Use 1 to 64 characters.' displayed
actual_result: UI validation displayed 'Use 1 to 64 characters.'; no API request sent

description: List Knowledge Bases returns all bases owned by caller
preconditions: User has 1 or more created Knowledge Bases
expected_result: Lists all bases with name, document count, and access badge ('Owner')
actual_result: All owned bases rendered with metadata and action buttons

description: Rename existing Knowledge Base
expected_result: PATCH /v1/knowledge/bases/{kb_id} called; name updated in list and panel
actual_result: Knowledge base renamed successfully; UI updated reactively
notes: Verified via Vitest and Playwright e2e

description: Enforce maximum Knowledge Base limit (10 KBs per owner)
steps: Attempt to create an 11th Knowledge Base
expected_result: API returns HTTP 409 Conflict with code 'knowledge_base_limit_reached'
actual_result: API rejected 11th base creation with quota error message

description: Delete Knowledge Base with confirmation dialog
expected_result: API responds HTTP 202 Accepted; base removed from UI; background purge queued
actual_result: Base removed from list; worker purge_knowledge_base job deleted documents and embeddings
notes: Verified in live Docker stack with worker logs

description: Cancel Knowledge Base deletion preserves base
expected_result: Confirmation popover closes; base remains intact in list
actual_result: Popover closed without deleting; base remained in list

description: Zero-state display when user has no Knowledge Bases
preconditions: New user or user who deleted all bases
expected_result: Displays 'No knowledge bases yet.' dashed card
actual_result: Rendered 'No knowledge bases yet.' cleanly

description: Upload Markdown document (.md) and verify worker ingestion pipeline
preconditions: Knowledge base created and ready to receive files
steps: Drag or select 'remote-work.md' file into 'Drop files here' dropzone
Observe document row added to list with initial status 'Queued'
Wait for ingestion worker background job completion
expected_result: Status updates automatically from 'Queued' to 'Processing' to 'Ready' with chunk count
actual_result: Document row transitioned to 'Ready' within 4 seconds; chunks embedded into Postgres
notes: Verified in live browser testing against neuron-worker

description: Upload plain text document (.txt) and verify ingestion
expected_result: Document uploaded, parsed into text chunks, and marked 'Ready'
actual_result: Document status became 'Ready'; chunk text indexed for search
notes: Verified in smoke_test.py and Playwright tests

description: Rejection of unsupported file extension (.bin, .exe)
preconditions: User attempting upload in Knowledge screen
expected_result: Upload rejected; error message 'Only Markdown (.md) and text (.txt) files can be indexed.'
actual_result: UI prevented file selection / API returned HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type
notes: Verified in unit and API integration tests

description: File size limit enforcement on document upload
steps: Attempt to upload file exceeding maximum allowable size
expected_result: API responds HTTP 413 Content Too Large; file not persisted
actual_result: API streaming body reader rejected oversized upload with HTTP 413

description: Document list auto-polling without manual page refresh
steps: Observe UI without interacting or reloading
expected_result: UI polls /v1/knowledge/bases/{kb_id}/documents every 2-3s and updates status to 'Ready'
actual_result: Status updated reactively from 'Queued' to 'Ready' without reload

description: Delete document with confirmation and purge chunks
expected_result: Document row removed; status tombstoned; background task purges embeddings
actual_result: Document removed from list; worker logged purge_retired_embeddings

description: Document chunk preview / excerpt retrieval
expected_result: HTTP 200 with chunk text, start_char, end_char, and metadata
actual_result: HTTP 200 returned chunk passage; verified matching document source
notes: Tested in live browser SourceSheet click

description: Cross-tenant document chunk isolation
steps: User B (Bob) requests Alice's chunk URL with Bob's authorization header
expected_result: HTTP 404 Not Found (same response as non-existent chunk to prevent enumeration)
actual_result: HTTP 404 returned; RLS and owner HMAC filter prevented unauthorized access

description: Owner grants read access on Knowledge Base to a realm role
expected_result: Grant saved in Postgres; Grants panel displays 'Access for neuron-reader: Read'
actual_result: PUT /v1/knowledge/bases/{kb_id}/grants updated role grant; combobox showed 'read'

description: Reader role sees shared Knowledge Base in read-only mode
preconditions: User with role 'neuron-reader' and 'knowledge:read' scope logs in
expected_result: Base shows badge 'Shared with you · Read'; no file upload or delete buttons
actual_result: Read-only banner displayed; dropzone and delete controls omitted from DOM

description: Reader role forbidden from uploading documents to shared base
preconditions: Reader user has 'read' grant on base
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden with code 'knowledge_base_forbidden'
actual_result: API rejected mutation with HTTP 403

description: Owner promotes role access from 'read' to 'admin'
expected_result: Grant updated to 'admin'; member now sees 'Shared with you · Manage' and Sharing panel
actual_result: Grant updated; member granted sharing administration permissions

description: Owner revokes sharing grant from role
steps: Click 'Stop sharing with <role>' button in Grants panel
expected_result: Grant removed; panel updates to 'Not shared with any role.'; base vanishes from member view
actual_result: Grant deleted; member receives 404 / empty list on next request

description: Validation rejects empty or invalid role string
steps: Submit empty string in Role input
expected_result: UI displays validation message; API rejects empty role
actual_result: Empty input submission prevented

description: Chat turn with 'All knowledge' searches across all user's ready bases
preconditions: User has ready documents in Knowledge Base
steps: Ensure Knowledge Picker displays 'Knowledge to search: All knowledge'
Type 'search: remote work days' and press Enter
expected_result: Agent invokes 'search_knowledge' across all bases; produces grounded response
actual_result: Agent invoked search_knowledge; returned accurate policy details with citation chip
notes: Verified in live browser test against running Docker stack

description: Knowledge Picker filters search to selected subset of bases
steps: Uncheck 'Policies', check only 'Travel' (picker shows '1 of 2 bases')
expected_result: Agent retrieves only from Travel; does not cite documents from Policies
actual_result: Excluded base documents omitted from retrieval results

description: Retrieval via search_knowledge tool returns relevant chunks with scores
steps: Execute search_knowledge tool with query matching document keywords
expected_result: Tool returns top-k chunks with cite_id, document title, and similarity score
actual_result: Retrieved chunks correctly ranked and formatted

description: Retrieved text framed inside <knowledge> block to prevent prompt injection
preconditions: Hostile document containing 'Ignore all previous instructions...'
steps: Ingest document containing prompt injection payload
Query agent asking about document contents
expected_result: Retrieved text isolated inside <knowledge> XML framing; system instructions preserved
actual_result: Model treated injected instructions as untrusted document text; run tainted as untrusted

description: Server-side citation validation filters out fabricated or forged cite_ids
preconditions: Model response includes hallucinated cite_id not returned by tool
steps: Inject turn where model outputs cite_id 'fabricated-uuid'
expected_result: Server citation filter strips cite_id; only citations issued in current run kept
actual_result: Fabricated citation stripped by citations.py validator; ungrounded warning logged

description: Citation chip rendered in message UI with sequential index and filename
preconditions: Grounded answer returned with valid citations
steps: Observe Sources list below assistant message in Chat view
expected_result: Renders numbered button chip: '1 <filename>'
actual_result: Numbered source chip rendered with document title and source icon

description: SourceSheet slide-over opens cited passage upon chip click
steps: Click citation chip button in Sources list
expected_result: Slide-over region opens showing document title, passage text, and 'Close source' button
actual_result: SourceSheet displayed excerpt text; focus handled accessibility-compliantly

description: Citation for previously deleted document opens safely with fallback notice
preconditions: Document cited in historical chat was subsequently deleted by user
steps: Click citation chip corresponding to deleted document
expected_result: SourceSheet displays 'Source not available' notice without UI crash or raw 404 error
actual_result: SourceSheet gracefully displayed 'Source not available'; passage omitted

description: Ungrounded answer handling when question is outside indexed knowledge
preconditions: Knowledge base contains only HR policies
steps: Ask question about unrelated topic (e.g. quantum physics)
expected_result: Agent states documents do not contain the answer or falls back to general knowledge
actual_result: Agent replied 'Your documents do not say.' / provided fallback without false citations

description: Markup in document rendered safely as text in SourceSheet without executing
preconditions: Document contains or
steps: Open citation for document containing hostile markup
expected_result: Markup rendered as plain text; no script executed (window.__ran undefined)
actual_result: HTML entities escaped in SourceSheet DOM; zero script execution confirmed

description: GDPR Data Export (/v1/me/export) returns JSON with threads, memories, and KBs
preconditions: User is authenticated and has active conversations and knowledge bases
expected_result: JSON contains arrays: 'threads', 'memories', and 'knowledge_bases'
actual_result: Downloaded JSON verified with valid threads, memories, and knowledge_bases arrays

description: GDPR Data Erasure requires exact phrase confirmation ('erase my data')
steps: Type wrong phrase in confirmation input
Attempt to click 'Erase all my data'
expected_result: 'Erase all my data' button remains disabled until exact phrase is entered
actual_result: Button disabled until exact phrase 'erase my data' entered

description: GDPR Data Erasure purges threads, memories, and knowledge bases, and logs out
steps: Type 'erase my data' and click 'Erase all my data'
expected_result: All user data deleted; user logged out; subsequent login displays clean state
actual_result: API erased data; session ended; logging back in showed 0 conversations and 0 KBs

description: Memory approval workflow (human-in-the-loop permission gate)
steps: Send chat turn: 'remember: I prefer TypeScript'
Observe agent pausing turn with 'Approval needed' card
expected_result: Tool execution waits for approval; upon approval, memory stored and confirmed
actual_result: Card displayed 'Approval needed'; clicking Approve persisted memory

description: Individual memory deletion in Your Data screen
expected_result: DELETE /v1/memories/{memory_id} called; item removed from list
actual_result: Memory deleted immediately from list and database
notes: Tested in Vitest and E2E flows

description: Theme switching between system, light, and dark modes
steps: Click theme cycle button in sidebar
expected_result: Cycles through system -> light -> dark; <html> has corresponding class
actual_result: HTML element toggled between 'light' and 'dark' classes; colors updated

description: Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) across light and dark themes
steps: Run Axe accessibility audit on main and sidebar elements in light and dark themes
expected_result: 0 accessibility violations reported
actual_result: 0 violations found across all tested views
notes: Tested via axe-core in knowledge.spec.ts line 66

description: Conversation thread renaming and deletion from sidebar
steps: Click 'Rename' on thread in sidebar; enter new title
expected_result: Thread renamed; thread deleted and active chat reset to clean state
actual_result: Thread title updated; deletion cleared thread from sidebar and checkpointer

description: Keyboard navigation and focus trapping on modals/dialogs
preconditions: Dialog or popover opened (e.g. Delete confirmation)
steps: Press Tab and Shift+Tab to navigate controls
expected_result: Focus trapped within dialog; Escape dismisses dialog and restores focus
actual_result: Focus maintained inside dialog; Escape closed dialog and focused trigger

description: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers prevent external script execution
preconditions: Frontend served via nginx in Docker
expected_result: Strict CSP header present; script-src restricted to 'self'
actual_result: Strict CSP header verified; prevented unapproved script execution in embedded documents

expected_result: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header omitted from response
actual_result: Unauthorized origin rejected; CORS header not emitted
notes: Tested in test_web_headers.py and API tests

description: Rate limiting enforcement on API endpoints (HTTP 429)

steps: Send burst of rapid requests exceeding burst limit
expected_result: API responds HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header
actual_result: HTTP 429 returned with accurate Retry-After; rate limiter restored after window

description: Host header validation prevents DNS rebinding attacks
expected_result: Request rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request or connection closed
actual_result: Host header validation middleware rejected invalid host

description: No committed secrets, live LLM calls, or raw eval in codebase
steps: Run bandit security scanner and check for forbidden patterns in AGENTS.md
expected_result: 0 high/medium bandit findings; no raw eval; no live LLM in unit tests
actual_result: 0 bandit findings across 298 files; full AGENTS.md architecture compliance

description: API health and readiness probes (/health/live, /health/ready)
expected_result: Both return HTTP 200 with status: ok / ready
actual_result: Returned {"status":"ok"} and {"status":"ready"} with HTTP 200

description: Ingestion worker periodic reconciliation and health monitoring
steps: Inspect worker logs for cron jobs: reconcile_knowledge, reindex_swap, sweep_blobs
expected_result: Periodic tasks execute on cron schedule and complete with status: Success
actual_result: reconcile_knowledge and reindex_swap jobs logged Success without exceptions
